sourceFile: 17.1 BRS-161014 C2+E2  Report test Center Dome improve bending of Ralon vender 16.2.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid comparable evidence but misclassifies the change and mispairs key function results.
issues: Change domain should be CD supplier/lot, not equipment.
Changed factor wrongly includes aggregate labels as conditions.
Function C2 and total comparisons use wrong controls and omit rows 39 and 43.
Vision C2 outcome is mislabeled from a picture row.
Measurement outcomes from header/summary rows are not citeable results.
correctionPlan: Set primary change to improved bending CD lot/supplier Ralon vs normal CD supplier GES.
Use E2, C2, and Total C2+E2 as subgroup or aggregate keys only.
Rebuild function outcomes: E2 row33 vs35 worse, C2 row37 vs39 no change, total row41 vs43 worse.
Rename vision outcomes by table section and compare E2 row14 vs15 and C2 row27 vs28.
Remove unsupported measurement outcomes from rows 32 and 36.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but semantic citations are insufficient until pairings and labels are corrected.
